questions.question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 100 cm. If one of the diagonals measures 14 cm, then the area of the rhombus is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side (s) = Perimeter ÷ 4 = 100 ÷ 4 = 25 cm.

One half-diagonal (d₁/2) = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm.

The other half-diagonal (d₂/2) = √(25² − 7²) = √(625 − 49) = 24 cm.

Area of Rhombus = 2 × (d₁/2) × (d₂/2) = 2 × 7 × 24 = 336 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 336 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__

questions.question: Simplify 13 - [7- (4 + 7) - {7 - (7 - 4 + 7)} + 14]
questions.solution:
Given:

Expression: 13 - [7 - (4 + 7) - {7 - (7 - 4 + 7)} + 14]

Formula used:

Use the BODMAS rule (Bracket, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction).

Calculations:

Step 1: Simplify the innermost brackets.

13 - [7 - (4 + 7) - {7 - (7 - 4 + 7)} + 14]

⇒ 13 - [7 - 11 - {7 - 10} + 14]

Step 2: Simplify the curly brackets.

⇒ 13 - [7 - 11 - {7 - 10} + 14]

⇒ 13 - [7 - 11 +3 + 14]

Step 3: Simplify the square brackets.

⇒ 13 - [7 - 11 + 3 + 14]

⇒ 13 - [13]

Step 4: Perform the subtraction.

⇒ 13 - 13 = 0

∴ The value of the expression is 0.

questions.question: Two bottles of the same capacity are 35% and 33 (1)/(3)\% full of orange juice, respectively they are filled up completely with apple juice and then the contents of both bottles are emptied into another vessel. The percentage of apple juice in the mixture is:
questions.solution:
33 (1)/(3)\% = 33 + (1)/(3)

As the capacity of both vessels is the same the average percentage of orange juice, in the new vessel = (35 + 33 + 1/3)/2 = 34 + 1/6 = 34(1)/(6)\%

Percentage of apple juice, in new vessel = 100% - 34(1)/(6)\% = 65(5)/(6)\%

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, PS is the height and QR is the base. PQ = 52, side QR = 56 and side PR = 60. What is the height of PS?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the triangle sides: **52, 56, 60**. These are multiples of **(13, 14, 15)** triangle by factor 4.

Area of (13, 14, 15) triangle is **84** sq. units.

Area of (52, 56, 60) triangle → 84 × 4² = 1344 sq. units.

Height **PS** = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 1344) ÷ 56 = 2688 ÷ 56 = 48.

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides of ΔPQR: **p = 56 (QR)**, **q = 60 (PR)**, **r = 52 (PQ)**.

**Formula Used:** Semi-perimeter **s = (a + b + c)/2** and Area **A = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67e54cbf9c28298b7efe3a8c9ac2a2033627996b5cd320fcdd417c6bf96c1a02.png] 

⇒ Semi-perimeter **s** = (52 + 56 + 60) ÷ 2 = 168 ÷ 2 = **84**

⇒ Area = √[84 × (84−56) × (84−60) × (84−52)]

⇒ Area = √[84 × 28 × 24 × 32]

⇒ Area = √[(28 × 3) × 28 × (8 × 3) × (8 × 4)]

⇒ Area = 28 × 3 × 8 × 2 = **1344** sq. units

⇒ Area of ΔPQR = (1/2) × Base × Height

⇒ 1344 = (1/2) × 56 × **PS**

⇒ 1344 = 28 × **PS**

⇒ **PS** = 1344 ÷ 28 = **48**

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of any triangle when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

Height of a Triangle

The altitude or height **h** corresponding to a base **b** is calculated as h = (2 × Area) ÷ b.

Standard 13-14-15 Triangle

A triangle with sides 13, 14, and 15 always has an area of 84. Scaling the sides by **k** scales the area by **k²**.</p

questions.question: If Rs.11800 is divided among three friends A, B and C in such a way that 2A = 5B = 7C then find the share of A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 
To find the **Ratio** of **A : B : C** from 2A = 5B = 7C, use the **LCM** method.
 
LCM of 2, 5, and 7 is 70.
 
**Ratio A : B : C** = 70/2 : 70/5 : 70/7 = 35 : 14 : 10.
 
**Share of A** = (35 ÷ (35 + 14 + 10)) × 11800 = (35 ÷ 59) × 11800 = 35 × 200 = ₹7000.
 
**∴ The correct answer is ₹7000.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 
**Given:** **Total Amount** = ₹11800 and **Condition** 2A = 5B = 7C.
 
**Formula Used:** If pA = qB = rC, then A : B : C = (1/p) : (1/q) : (1/r).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cbe2cd8404baaa9df04df6d9b6fd34a303093246dc45c4091441e761d1c2570.png] 
⇒ Let 2A = 5B = 7C = k
 
⇒ A = k/2, B = k/5, C = k/7
 
⇒ A : B : C = (1/2) : (1/5) : (1/7)
 
⇒ Multiply by 70: A : B : C = 35 : 14 : 10
 
⇒ Sum of ratios = 35 + 14 + 10 = 59
 
⇒ 59 units = 11800
 
⇒ 1 unit = 11800 ÷ 59 = 200
 
⇒ Share of A = 35 × 200 = 7000
 
**∴ The correct answer is ₹7000.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
 
Inverse Proportionality
 
When coefficients are given (pA = qB), the ratio of the variables is inversely proportional to their coefficients, i.e., A : B = q : p.
 
Ratio & Proportion Basics
 
To divide a quantity X in ratio a:b:c, the share of A = [a ÷ (a+b+c)] × X.
 
Compound Ratio
 
The compound ratio of a : b and c : d is found by multiplying corresponding terms: (a × c) : (b × d).

questions.question: A and B together a complete a task in 20 days. If A alone can complete the task in 24 days, find the number of days by B to complete the task alone.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For two entities, if (A+B) takes X days and A takes Y days, then B takes (X × Y) ÷ (Y − X) days.

Here, X = 20 days and Y = 24 days.

Days for B = (20 × 24) ÷ (24 − 20)

Days for B = 480 ÷ 4 = 120 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: A and B together take 20 days. A alone takes 24 days.

Formula: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A + B
 20

 6
 
 

 A
 24
 5
 
 

⇒ Total Work = LCM of 20 and 24 = 120 units.

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B) = 120 ÷ 20 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of A = 120 ÷ 24 = 5 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of B = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A = 6 − 5 = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Time taken by B = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time taken by B = 120 ÷ 1 = 120 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the efficiency of the workers when they work for the same amount of time.

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to time and work, but inlet pipes have positive efficiency and outlet (leak) pipes have negative efficiency.

Alternate Day Work

Calculate the work done in one cycle (e.g., 2 days if A and B work alternately) and then find the total cycles needed.</p

questions.question: The population of Varanasi is 2,25,000. If the annual birth rate and death rate are 9 % and 7 %, calculate the population of city after 2 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net annual growth rate = **Birth rate** − **Death rate** = 9% − 7% = 2%.

Effective growth for 2 years using successive formula (x + y + xy/100) = 2 + 2 + (2 × 2)/100 = 4.04%.

Final Population = 2,25,000 × (100 + 4.04)% = 2,25,000 × 1.0404 = 2,34,090.

**∴ The correct answer is 234090.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial population (P) = 2,25,000

Annual Birth Rate = 9%

Annual Death Rate = 7%

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Net Rate (R) = Birth Rate − Death Rate

Final Population = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a2ff9cab19f29a6e02a0c81750be37a3c93f9e242d604fb3d46a800a00db45c.png] 

⇒ Net Rate of growth (R) = 9% − 7% = 2% per annum

⇒ Population after 1st year = 2,25,000 × (1 + 2/100) = 2,25,000 × 1.02 = 2,29,500

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 2,29,500 × (1 + 2/100) = 2,29,500 × 1.02

⇒ Final Population = 2,34,090

**∴ The correct answer is 234090.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Growth Rate

When both birth and death rates are given, the **net annual growth** is calculated by subtracting the death rate from the birth rate.

Population Change Formula

The population after 'n' years is given by Pₙ = P(1 ± R/100)ⁿ, where **P** is initial population and **R** is rate of change.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by x% and then y%, the **effective percentage change** is (x + y + xy/100)%.</p

questions.question: Ratio between the Present ages of A & B is 5 : 4. If the age of A, 3 years ago is 2 years more than the age of B 4 years hence then find their total age.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Present ages** of **A : B** = 5 : 4

Difference in ages is constant. Let ratio be 5x and 4x.

Given: (5x − 3) − (4x + 4) = 2 ⇒ x − 7 = 2 ⇒ x = 9

Total Ratio units = 5 + 4 = 9 units

Total Age = 9 × 9 = 81 years

**∴ The correct answer is 81 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e280d8524199f5f9404ee9ac5443cea5ebeaac7ea07a54b0f96f7d61516eda0.png] 

**Given:** Present age ratio A : B = 5 : 4. Let age of A = 5x and B = 4x.

**Condition:** Age of A (3 years ago) = Age of B (4 years hence) + 2

⇒ (5x − 3) = (4x + 4) + 2

⇒ 5x − 3 = 4x + 6

⇒ 5x − 4x = 6 + 3

⇒ x = 9

⇒ Present age of A = 5 × 9 = 45 years

⇒ Present age of B = 4 × 9 = 36 years

⇒ Total present age = 45 + 36 = 81 years

**∴ The correct answer is 81 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Concept

If the ratio of ages is given as a:b, we assume the ages to be ax and bx. The **constant difference** between two people's ages remains the same throughout their lives.

Past and Future Ages

If the present age is 'x', then age 'n' years ago is (x − n) and age 'n' years hence is (x + n).

Sum and Ratio Relation

The total sum of ages at any point is the sum of their individual ratio parts multiplied by the common variable factor 'x'.</p

questions.question: If the simple interest on a sum of money for 5 years at 10% per annum is Rs. 900, what is the compound interest on the same at the same rate and for the 2 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest** rate for 5 years = 5 × 10% = 50%

Given 50% of **Principal** = ₹900 ⇒ 100% (**Principal**) = ₹1800

Effective **Compound Interest** rate for 2 years at 10% = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

**Compound Interest** = 21% of ₹1800 = 0.21 × 1800 = ₹378

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Simple Interest (SI) = ₹900, Time (T₁) = 5 years, Rate (R) = 10% p.a., Time for CI (T₂) = 2 years.

**Formula Used:** SI = (P × R × T)/100 | CI = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d403ac44da212a0c94a28084fafea38c4c5bb8ae5ff65586d6d8df65823938e4.png] 

⇒ 900 = (P × 10 × 5) / 100

⇒ 900 = P × 50 / 100 ⇒ 900 = P / 2

⇒ **Principal (P)** = ₹1800

⇒ CI = 1800 × [(1 + 10/100)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 1800 × [(1.1)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 1800 × [1.21 − 1] = 1800 × 0.21

⇒ **Compound Interest** = ₹378

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

For 2 years, the effective compound interest rate can be calculated using the successive percentage change formula: Rₑff = R₁ + R₂ + (R₁ × R₂)/100.

Difference between SI and CI

The difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years is given by the formula: CI − SI = P × (R/100)².

Compound Interest Formula

The amount (A) in compound interest is A = P(1 + R/100)T, and CI = A − P.

questions.question: A sum of money invested on compound interest for 2 years at 20% interest per annum would fetch Rs. 482 more as interest if the interest is compounded half-yearly than yearly. What is the sum invested?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Case 1: 

Total amount for 2 years of investment at 20% p.a. in CI

Case 2: 

Total amount for 2 years of investment at 20% compounding half yearly

Difference between the above two cases = Rs. 482

**Formula used:**

Total amount at CI = P × (1 + R/100)N

**Calculation:**

Let, the principal amount = P

According to the question,

P(1 + 10/100)⁴ - P(1 + 20/100)2 = 482

⇒ P(11/10)4 - P(6/5)2 = 482

⇒ P(1.1)⁴ - P(1.2)² = 482

⇒ P(1.4641 - 1.44) = 482 

⇒ P × 0.0241 = 482

⇒ P = 482/(0.0241) = Rs. 20,000

**∴ The sum invested is Rs. 20,000.**

questions.question: If the compound ratio of ratios (x ∶ 2) and (9 ∶ y) is 3 ∶ 4, then find the compound ratio of ratios (x + y) ∶ 5 and 2 ∶ y.
questions.solution:
The compound ratio of ratios a ∶ b and c ∶ d is ac ∶ bd.

⇒ 9x ∶ 2y = 3 ∶ 4

⇒ x/y = 2/9 × 3/4

⇒ x/y = 1/6 ----(1)

Similarly,

Compound ratio of ratios (x + y) ∶ 5 and 2 ∶ y = 2/5 × (x + y)/y = 2/5 × (x/y + 1)

Substituting from (1),

⇒ Compound ratio of ratios (x + y) ∶ 5 and 2 ∶ y = 2/5 × (1/6 + 1) = 2/5 × 7/6 = 7/15

∴ Compound ratio of ratios (x + y) ∶ 5 and 2 ∶ y = 7 ∶ 15

questions.question: Due to increase of 33.33% in the price of apples, a customer can purchase 4 apples less for Rs. 16. What is the original price (in paise) of an apple?
questions.solution:
Let the price of one apple originally be ‘a’ paise

And,

Let the total number of apples be ‘b’

⇒ Total price of apples = ab

Rs 16 = 1600 paise

⇒ 1600 = ab (given) 

⇒ New price of one apple = a(1 + 33.33/100) = 1.3333a

After the increase in price,

⇒ Number of apples = b – 4

⇒ 1600 = 1.3333a × (b – 4)

⇒ 1600 = 1.3333a × [(1600/a) – 4]

⇒ 1600 = (4a/3) × [(1600 – 4a)/a]

⇒ 1200 = 1600 – 4a

⇒ 400 = 4a

⇒ a = 100

∴ the correct option is 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

After an increase of 33.33% in the price of apples, a customer can purchase 4 apples less for Rs. 16. 

So, 33.33% of Rs. 16 is the price of 4 apples

Now price of 4 apples after increment = 16 of 33.33% 

⇒ Price of 4 apples after increment = 16 × (1/3) 

⇒ Price of one apple after increment = (16/3) × (1/4) = 4/3 

Price of one apple before increament = 4/3 × 3/4 = Rs. 1 = 100 paise 

**∴ Price of one apple before increament is 100 paise.**
